# Current project status and finite-rule inventory

<!-- Generated by scripts/check_docs.py --write-status; edit docs/project-status.json. -->

Selected product version: **0.2.0**. Release state: 0.2.0 release scope finalized on 2026-09-29: [finite interfaces and experimental Lean foundation](v0.2.0-plan.md) retained; migration and release validation recorded separately; remaining shared-QPE work and unchanged feature gates moved to the compatible [0.2.1 target](v0.2.1-plan.md), or 0.3.0 if a public break is necessary; CBits spelling retained; [structural type contract and tuple migration](type-system.md) implemented with distinct n-ary/nested types; Rust is the default for unresolved type/ownership design; finite X2–X6 implemented and tested; [Lean migration](lean-kernel-migration.md) adopted with proved experimental phase-word and [shared-DAG](lean-hierarchy-slice.md) executables plus [typed layout](lean-layout-slice.md) permutation/reference proofs and [shared typed call](lean-layout-dag-slice.md) graph soundness, now joined by [sparse phase/layout](lean-phase-layout-slice.md) composition proofs and [interference/complex interpretation](lean-interference-slice.md) and [actual QFT circuit/Fourier proofs](lean-qft-proof-packet.md), extended to an [accepted typed graph projection](lean-qft-graph-packet.md), plus [QPE residual-instrument, coherent controlled-power and conditional completeness proofs](lean-qpe-instrument-packet.md); [Qleisli Soundness Theorem / S05-C1–C5](release-milestones.md#qleisli-soundness-theorem-v050) targeted for v0.5.0 with community expansion thereafter, not yet achieved; [Physical Realizability Theorem / PR-C1–C4](release-milestones.md#physical-realizability-theorem-v1) and a proved Lean backend adopted as v1 requirements, not yet implemented or proved; production acceptance remains Rust; component schema types/source are pinned; typed artifact preparation derives dependencies, binds exact proof endpoints and shares its budget with the proved acyclic scheduler and actual whole-definition and meaning/encoding typing checks; explicit Bits/Bit, tuple and empty-owner conversions now have checked actual inverse routing and reference coefficient round trips; controlled powers now project actual implementation/meaning bodies and retain explicit provider-proof obligations with operator/reference theorems; a supported whole-space derivation pass now checks actual rules and provider premises from an empty cache, with proved finite closure and constructed equal, unique complex operator/reference denotations for supported accepted rules, without an assumed interpretation environment; whole-space unitarity, full-profile semantics, hierarchy/schema integration, sized source, reference execution and H1–H5 remain pending in the 0.2.1 continuation; all external schema entries remain disabled; [QLT design and TQL-0 source records](qlt-design.md) adopted for a future 0.3–0.4 Rust experiment and later independent Lean migration; no QLT runtime implemented; [Lean-assisted mathematical debugger](lean-debugger-plan.md) adopted as future 0.x.0 tooling with no selected version, implementation or new release gate; [release record](releases/v0.2.0.md#release-validation-and-publication) and [GitHub publication evidence](https://github.com/MGYamada/Qleisli/releases/tag/v0.2.0).
See the [validation/publication record](releases/v0.2.0.md).

This view is generated from [project-status.json](project-status.json) and the project manifests.
It centralizes current scheduling states and an initial rule/implementation/test/proof inventory.
The inventory names inspected boundaries and existing regressions; it is not a complete
conformance audit, a test execution report or a proof of Rust acceptance soundness.
Dated execution evidence remains in the [conformance history](specification-status.md).
